integrity: The same-object kinetic equations and equilibrium are supported by the 2013 and 2014 full-text mathematical studies. Conditional flux and covariance relations follow analytically from compact invariance, antiderivative generator testing and the total-concentration balance. The archived verification script checks only the exact algebraic identities, not novelty or the analytical invariant-measure argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compact invariant probability measures in the nonnegative quadrant and does not establish a limit cycle for all parameters.
The conditional flux laws do not determine complete conditional distributions.
The second-order formulas do not fix the variance of total concentration.
Equivalent short invariant-measure computations may exist in unindexed chemical-oscillator literature.
Existing Schnakenberg limit-cycle results already imply crossings of the equilibrium level for surrounding cycles.
title: Fiberwise flux calibration and exact anticorrelation in the Schnakenberg oscillator
